subject.title: feat(clients): show live plan checklists in web, iOS, and Android chat

question: After the web run-identity defect is fixed, should this protected cross-client UI PR wait for live web, iOS, and Android proof or receive a maintainer proof override?
rationale: The feature is directly visible on three clients, while the submitted evidence exercises only tests and static checks.

options.title: Require live client proof
options.body: Request a web recording plus iOS and Android simulator or device recordings showing updates, expansion, and run-end clearing.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer may manually verify all three clients and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

recommendation.title: Require live client proof
recommendation.body: Request a web recording plus iOS and Android simulator or device recordings showing updates, expansion, and run-end clearing.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged typed-plan work makes this person the strongest available owner for deciding its client UX proof threshold.
